name: th1-ai/hostaway-pp-cli
what_it_holds: Typed Go CLI + MCP server wrapping the Hostaway PMS API: portfolio pipeline, channel-parity drift detection, owner statements, bulk calendar/messaging, with a local SQLite mirror of the pulled data.
why_useful: Only pulls data the caller's own Hostaway account can see (needs an API key tied to a specific property manager's portfolio) — not a public market dataset. Cataloguing only because it shows the shape of PMS operational data (rates, channel-parity, occupancy) that in principle could be assembled if the team had operator relationships.
themes: Property-management / channel-manager / PMS public data (Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Beds24, iCal feeds) and vacation-rental manager benchmarks

name: mobin-torabi/pricing-tracker
what_it_holds: "Portable daily tracker for Rental Ninja & Lodgify pricing into your own Google Sheets" — a script that logs an operator's own listing prices day over day.
why_useful: Shows a pattern (daily price-tracking into a spreadsheet) that could in principle be repointed at public listing pages for a point-in-time price panel, but as shipped it only tracks the user's own PMS-connected listings.
